def solution(lst, n_largest_elements):
    # Example: solution([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3) -> 60
    # Implement the function body (no input(), no main).

    from functools import reduce
    from operator import mul
    
    # Sort the list and take the n largest elements
    lst_largest = sorted(lst)[-n_largest_elements:]
    
    # Calculate the product of the n largest elements
    prod = reduce(mul, lst_largest, 1)
    
    return prod


# Check function to verify the correctness of the solution
def check_solution():
    assert solution([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3) == 60, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert solution([10, 20, 30, 40, 50], 2) == 900, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert solution([-10, -20, 5, 1], 2) == 200, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert solution([1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 5) == 1, "Test case 4 failed"
    print("All test cases passed!")


check_solution()
